lines.en: It was a normal day in the life of Makoto Miyamura.
She was sitting behind the desk of her family’s porn shop, reading one of just three or four books sold in Kumon-mi and thinking to herself-
Wait, no. Actually — it was a different book. But they all have the same cover due to asset limitations or something like that. Yeah.
But anyway, she was reading it and thinking to herself, “Wow. I’m really fucking bored.” Which you might also be thinking right now as you’re reading this. And you know — fair.
We’re well past due for a reset by now and, without a clear direction to head in order to invoke (or evoke or whichever voke was correct there) one, it sometimes feels like things are dragging on.
It sometimes feels like we’re just repeating the same thing over and over again and- oh. I get it.
In that case, why don’t we shake things up a bit?
A book was sitting behind the desk of the Miyamura family porn shop and reading one of the Miyamuras. There we go. That should keep you held over until something traumatic happens again.
So, as it was sitting there or standing or hovering or whatever it was doing, it was thinking to itself, “Woah, hot girl.” And it was right.

So it stuffed her into its little book mouth and started chewing on her until the top half was all mushy and gross and the bottom half was still able to be penetrated by anyone with a necrophilia kink.
There we go. That was fun. Unlike real life — in which Makoto Miyamura was still just reading a book.
But what makes it even more boring is that she’s been doing this ever since the last beach trip ended while waiting for the newest Touka event to trigger.
: Ahem.
Oh, look. There it goes now.
: One pornography please.
: What flavor would you like?
: Uhh...
: Just the...regular one will do.
: Small, medium, or large?
: Medium, please. And a cup of green tea as well. Thank you.
: Sure. Just show me your membership card and I’ll get that started for you.
: M...Membership card?
: Of course. You can’t buy porn in Japan without a membership card. Is this your first time?
: N-No! Of course not. I just...I left it at home! But surely you’re willing to overlook such a careless mistake and...provide the pornography regardless, correct?
: Only if you do the pornography dance. I sadly can’t help you without receiving dance moves as collateral in lieu of your porn membership.
: Pornography-
: Dance-
: Provide-
: Please-
: What the hell is that supposed to be?
: I apologize for such a pathetic display. I never learned the dance.
It was no longer a boring day for Makoto Miyamura.
: Why are you here, Touka?
: H-How did you know it was me?!
: Because there’s no one else in the entire world that would have fallen for that.
: Wha- I knew that dance must have been a lie!
: You just wait until I receive my pornography membership card! You’ll be sorry to have crossed me then!
: You know you can just watch porn for free on the Internet, right?
: Well...y...yes. But...
: I learned recently in a...very embarrassing way that Internet traffic isn’t exactly...private.
: It sounds to me like you just need NordVPN.
: N-NordVPN?
: Cybersecurity. Built for everyday.
: Staying safe online is becoming increasingly difficult thanks to malicious hackers and companies who want to sell your information and search history for profit.
: But with NordVPN, you can change your IP address from your very own computer, making you harder to track and securing your privacy.
: Why thank you, Makoto. I’ll have to look into this product when I get home as it was quite difficult having to explain my search history to my overly-curious mother.
: Don’t mention it. Just be sure to use the code MAKOTO5 at checkout for 20%% off your order.
: This message has not been formally sponsored or endorsed by NordVPN.
: Oh, look. All of the little logos are suddenly fading away.
: Yeah, product placement’s been getting out of hand lately. Why are you really here, though? Is it seriously just for porn? Because we have other stuff too, you know.
: I know. I’m still waiting on my green tea.
: No, I meant like toys and costumes and all sorts of stuff like that. And I make commission on these things called DildoSabers that-
: Oh, n...no. My mother has made sure I have all of...those objects I could...ever possibly need. They’re just...intimidating.
: Yeah. You get used to it.
: Sometimes too used to it.
: Do you have any...educational materials, perhaps? Secret...resources that only members of the lower class would know about?
: I mean...we have Girls Gone Wild.
: What’s that?
: A series of DVDs featuring mainly American girls.
: What do they do, exactly?
: ...Go wild?
: I’m not really sure what else to tell you.
: Ugh...just the green tea then. I suppose I’ll have to figure things out elsewhere.
: You know...it’s getting close to closing time. Do you want to come up to my room and talk for a little while? That’s where all the tea is anyway.
: Well, I...suppose it wouldn’t hurt.
: But I’ve also been taught to exercise caution when people in what my family refers to as “seedy areas” invite me anywhere. And I believe this establishment meets that criteria.
: Which is something I’d agree with basically every single time except this one since I just happen to live here by a bad stroke of luck and am not sexually attracted to girls.
: Oh, excellent. I am also not sexually attracted to girls. I am excited to bond over this shared connection with you over tea.
: Please don’t make it weird.
: With all due respect, you are making this just as weird as I am.
And so the two of them made their way up the stairs and into Makoto’s bedroom.
The pictures lining the stairway had all been removed, so this new set of eyes was deprived of the same experience an older set had just a short while ago.
It was back when hope had only just begun decaying. But now, it’s had ample time to decompose, and all that remains is a shell of what once was.
But to that shell’s left was a skeleton that still wore fresh meat. Which, of course, had spawned some jealousy. But not the type that would warrant cyanide-laced tea.
It was the type that filled her with an indescribable emptiness — and the depressing, untimely realization that she’d given herself up long before she was destined to.
: You don’t have to sit seiza-style, Touka. There’s no expectation of formality once you’re invited into someone’s room.
: I actually prefer to sit this way. It feels more comfortable.
: That feels more comfortable? Really?
: As the heir to the Tsukioka Foundation, I’ve been sitting in on formal presentations and meetings ever since I was a girl. Almost all of which required me to appear as proper as possible.
: So yes, I suppose this just feels more natural for me.
: Weird. The only times we ever had to do that in my family were when we went out to fancy restaurants. And even then, my mom always complained about it.
: How interesting. I continue to be intrigued by your people’s ways of life.
: So, tell me — what is it you want to know about sex?
: Wha- why are we back to that all of a sudden?!
: That’s what you came here for, right?
: I doubt we have any sort of “reference materials” that your family wouldn’t already have access to. But if you have any specific questions, I might be able to help.
: And you...wouldn’t mind doing that?
: Not at all. I’m supposed to be open about that sort of thing given my job and whatnot.
: Oh, thank heavens. Because I tried talking to Chika about this, but she was just so...graphic.
: It’s kind of hard not to be sometimes. Sex is super intimate, and letting someone literally inside of you is kind of a...graphic thing.
: Is it truly as...painful as it sounds?
: It’s different for everybody. Some people actually enjoy their first time. It’s definitely weird, though. But, like...a good kind of weird.
: Is it just the pain part you’re worried about?
: Well...no.

: If anything, I’d say that’s one of the things I’m least concerned about. I’ve received an...extremely detailed and lengthy explanation about how sexual intercourse works and...what to expect physically.
: It’s the emotional aspect of it I’m struggling to understand as that was never covered in any of the presentations I watched.
: Uh...presentations?
: I think my biggest question right now is...when is the right time to engage in that sort of conduct?
: At what point is such a thing acceptable and...how am I supposed to act when that time does come? Do I just...remove my clothes and lie there? Am I meant to be the aggressor?
: Who initiates what? How long does it go on for? How frequently does such a thing even occur between partners?
: That’s what you’re worried about?
: I have no romantic experience whatsoever, so...all of this just feels strange and...new to me.
: Yeah...that’ll happen. But I think that’s meant to be part of the fun.
: Meeting someone and learning that you want to do that stuff with them is, like...the first real step to growing up, I think. Or at least becoming a “woman.”

: My mom always says that sex is like a dance, but I think that extends to romance as a whole. And the hardest part of learning any dance with a partner is learning how to not step on their feet. Probably.
: I don’t know. I’ve never danced before.
: Technically, you’re not far off. Simply learning to control one’s body as a whole is the most difficult part of dancing. I’m formally trained in five different styles.
: I never would have known based on your porn dance from earlier.
: I once again apologize for such a terrible, inappropriate display. I haven’t felt that embarrassed since I learned how to use a vending machine.
: There’s nothing to be embarrassed about, Touka. This whole situation is one that’s essentially impossible to be comfortable with at first.
: It was the same for me and I legitimately grew up hearing my mom get railed down the hall on a weekly basis.
: Oh, I’ve played that game before!
: ...Game?
: Yes. My whole family played the railing game just before we learned what tacos are.
: ...Okay.
: Anyway, the point is that it’s fine to not know how any of this stuff works yet as long as you know how to, like...actually do it.
: And even then, you’re probably going to find yourself just letting your partner “do his thing” most of the time since that partner is probably going to be Sensei and he likes to be in control.
: Uhhh wh- what? No. I never said that. Why would you bring him up? That’s crazy. You’re a crazy girl. You say crazy things. What? Sensei? No. That’s ridiculous. What?
: Touka, it’s fine. I’m not going to tell anyone. Besides, I’m sure he’d be willing to help you with all of this too if you only asked.
: But I guess the reason you’re asking the girls instead is because you don’t want to embarrass yourself in front of him. Which, hey — fair. I’m no stranger to wanting to impress that guy.
: How...do you know all of this, exactly?
: Oh, is that not obvious? I’ve been having sex with him for years.
: You what?
: He’s screwed me so many times by now that I’m pretty sure I could accurately choose his dick out of a line of like...one thousand penises.
: That’s so many...what are they all doing there?
: His is enormous, though. So picking it out probably wouldn’t be hard even if he only screwed me one time instead of hundreds.
: How...
: How large would you say “enormous” is exactly?...
: Mmm...maybe like this?
: Dear lord.
: Yeaaaah.
: He’s good with it too.
: Any more questions, Touka?
: Yes. Who are you?
: Teacher’s pet, of course.
: He can do anything he wants to me any time he wants to do it.
: Which is why I’m hoping you fail. No offense.
: You won’t, of course. You’re beautiful. And Sensei would have sex with pretty much anyone to begin with. So if by some stroke of luck you manage to fail, that means more sex for me.
: Now what? Want me to get as graphic as Chika did? Because I’m sure I have plenty of stories for you if you want to hear them.
: I actually think it’s time for me to go home.
: Wait, Touka. You’ve barely touched your tea. Why not sit back down and finish it up while I tell you about the time he walked in on me masturbating downstairs?
: N-No thank you! It is very late!
: Or the time he took my virginity at our first Halloween party...
: G-Goodnight, Makoto!
: Goodnight!
: Ugghhhh! When will it ever end?!
Makoto Miyamura slams her head down onto her table while instinctively reaching toward the same book she was stuck in at the beginning of the event.
Touka Tsukioka, on the other hand, elects to walk back to the dorm instead of calling one of her drivers.
When she arrives there, she checks to make sure her roommate is asleep before unlocking a secret compartment built into the foot of her bed.
Then she slides open a drawer and rummages through a seemingly endless supply of sex toys, hoping to find one that matches the size Makoto showed her roughly one hour ago.
: Ah!
But then she accidentally turns one on and scares herself.
: Mn...Touka?...Is that you?...
: No! I mean...yes!
: What are you-
: Nothing! Goodnight, Yasu! Sweet dreams!
She once again goes to sleep without using any of them.
But it takes her hours this time as her mind has trouble returning from its adventure into the sewers.
Both Touka and Makoto’s affection increased by 1! And you didn’t even have to do anything this time!
